high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in a room with a rustic aesthetic. The individual is wearing a light blue leotard with a matching skirt, paired with white tights and a white long-sleeved cardigan. They are holding a smartphone in their right hand, which has a white case, to capture the photo. The mirror frame is made of woven rope, giving it a natural and textured appearance. The reflection in the mirror reveals part of the room behind the person, including a bed with white bedding and a pink pillow, and a dark curtain partially drawn to the side.
